Independently valid rows establish five-of-five passes at disabled 0.24 and enabled 0.56, five-of-five baseline failures at 0.28, a 2.33x tested pass-point ratio and an identifiable sustained-capacity improvement of at least 2.0x. Public claims are limited accordingly.

Cost-bounded four-way ablation of current KleidiAI, ORT thread tuning, mimalloc, and combined thread/memory tuning. Only a candidate passing the frozen 0.62 r/s screen receives five matched 300-second confirmations; the 125-minute ceiling keeps cumulative spend below $15.

The combined thread-memory treatment passed all five 0.62 r/s confirmations under the 10-second p95 SLO while the current KleidiAI runtime failed all five; generated outputs were identical, THP was restored, every archived checksum verified, and AWS cleanup completed. A separate isolation experiment is required before attributing causality among thread tuning, mimalloc, and THP.

Short factorial isolation of THP-only, thread-plus-THP, and mimalloc-plus-THP against current at 0.62 r/s. It identifies mechanism direction but does not replace EXP-2026-015 sustained confirmation; the 35-minute ceiling keeps cumulative spend below $15.

At 0.62 r/s, THP-only reduced median screen p95 by 23.14%, thread-plus-THP by 20.74%, and mimalloc-plus-THP by 43.06% relative to current. Outputs were identical, THP was restored, every archived checksum verified, and AWS cleanup completed. These short screens isolate mechanism direction and do not replace EXP-2026-015 sustained confirmation.

One-sided sustained confirmation of the simplified KleidiAI plus mimalloc and THP recipe without regressive thread overrides. Five frozen 300-second windows at 0.62 r/s must all pass and match the output digest established by EXP-2026-015 and EXP-2026-016; the 40-minute ceiling keeps cumulative spend below $15.
